hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook implementing a custom constant-sum curve: on each swap it takes input from the PoolManager, converts via phiEth deposit or withdraw, and settles output directly — bypassing concentrated liquidity math. Liquidity addition is permanently disabled, and the pool is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
